protocol.hypothesis: A causally confirmed price ZigZag combined with a separate RSI ZigZag may improve annual net return and monthly risk over price-only, oscillator-only and same-stock buy-and-hold controls on MOEX 1H/4H. Target for inspection: >20% net return over the latest complete 12 months on an individual stock; no performance guarantee.

research_provenance.implementation: mechanical adaptation, not exact Pine port
research_provenance.note: The publication describes two separate recursive zigzags and gives no trade rule; this test uses level-zero causally confirmed swings only.

required_data: confirmed price and RSI pivot timestamps
protocol.availability_lag: Price and RSI pivots are only usable after wing completed bars to the right; close-time signals fill at next open.
protocol.signal_semantics: Per-stock long/short signal from closed 1H or 4H bar; next open execution; no historical pivot-marker entry.
protocol.evaluation_unit: Independent per-stock experimental account; one common parameter setting chosen by early ranking for paper review.

mechanisms: price breakout aligned with latest RSI pivot direction
entry_design.confirmation: wing 3 or 5 completed bars; price swing reversal 2% or 4%; oscillator swing reversal 3 RSI points
entry_design.common_exit_rule: opposite entry signal or 24 completed bars
not_applicable: higher recursive levels without source parity
intrabar stop without tick-level execution data

untested_dependencies: Independent price and oscillator pivot wings: combined variants tie both wings to the same 3 or 5 bars

protocol.parameter_rationale: 3/5 right-wing bars test short and medium swing confirmation; 2/4% price reversal; RSI7/14 short and standard periods. Each declared combination is evaluated. Level zero is deliberate because the author describes no trading rule for higher levels. Price and oscillator wings are tied in combined variants; independent wing interactions remain untested.
protocol.baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on same stock/timeframe, next-open fill
protocol.signal_rule: Price breakout crosses a previously confirmed high/low. RSI swing is an alternating local extremum confirmed after wing bars and at least 3 RSI points reversal. Trend variant permits price breakout only when prior RSI swing direction agrees. Divergence variant requires last two confirmed price and RSI same-side pivots within 2*wing centers, with price lower low/RSI higher low or price higher high/RSI lower high. Signal at later confirmation, next-open fill. No pivot backdating.
protocol.execution_timing: Decision on completed bar; fill next open; 25% of equity per position.
protocol.rebalance_rule: At new signal or exit only
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Rank all complete variants on early period; check latest complete 12-month net return >20% per stock as user target and current policy paper threshold separately. Latest history has already influenced design and is not independent validation.
limitations: This is not an exact implementation of Trendoscope source code or recursive levels.
Corporate-action and short borrow coverage incomplete.
Selection history is seen; profitable backtest is not independent forward evidence.
